raw_text:
PLAN "12-week General Strength, Post-L4-L5 Precautions"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Build general strength with low spinal load and no loaded spinal flexion"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 - Foundation & Motor Control" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Lower - Unloaded Spine":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          split_squat 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Upper - Horizontal Push/Pull":
        warmup:
          arm_circles 5m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x6..8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          seated_row 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          incline_press 3x8 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          face_pull 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Core & Posterior Chain":
        warmup:
          marching 5m
        main straight_sets:
          plank 3x30s rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          bird_dog 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          back_extension 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          dead_bug 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 5m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Lower - Unloaded Spine":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x8..10 rpe 6..7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x8..10 rpe 6..7 rest 90 seconds
          split_squat 3x8..10 rpe 6..7 rest 75 seconds
          calf_raise 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Upper - Horizontal Push/Pull":
        warmup:
          arm_circles 5m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x6..8 rpe 6..7 rest 90 seconds
          seated_row 3x8..10 rpe 6..7 rest 75 seconds
          incline_press 3x8 rpe 6..7 rest 75 seconds
          face_pull 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 50m "Core & Posterior Chain":
        warmup:
          marching 5m
        main straight_sets:
          plank 3x35s rpe 6..7 rest 45 seconds
          bird_dog 3x8..10 rpe 6..7 rest 45 seconds
          back_extension 3x10..12 rpe 6..7 rest 60 seconds
          dead_bug 3x10..12 rpe 6..7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 5m
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Lower - Unloaded Spine Strength":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          step_up 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          calf_raise 3x12 rpe 6..7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 55m "Upper - Progressive Overload":
        warmup:
          arm_circles 5m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x5..6 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          seated_row 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12 rpe 6..7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 50m "Core & Posterior Chain":
        warmup:
          marching 5m
        main straight_sets:
          plank 4x35s rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
          bird_dog 3x10 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
          back_extension 4x8..10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          pallof_press 3x10 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 5m
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Lower - Capacity":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 4x6..8 rpe 7..8 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 4x6..8 rpe 7..8 rest 90 seconds
          walking_lunge 3x10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          calf_raise 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 55m "Upper - Capacity":
        warmup:
          arm_circles 5m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x5..6 rpe 7..8 rest 120 seconds
          seated_row 4x6..8 rpe 7..8 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 3x8 rpe 7..8 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 50m "Core & Posterior Chain - Capacity":
        warmup:
          marching 5m
        main straight_sets:
          plank 4x40s rpe 7..8 rest 45 seconds
          bird_dog 3x10 rpe 7..8 rest 45 seconds
          back_extension 4x8..10 rpe 7..8 rest 60 seconds
          pallof_press 3x12 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          spinal_twist 5m

  PHASE "Phase 2 - Strength Emphasis, Low Spinal Load" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Lower - Hinge Emphasis":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          trap_bar_deadlift 4x4..6 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          split_squat 3x8 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Upper - Vertical & Horizontal":
        warmup:
          arm_circles 5m
        main straight_sets:
          dumbbell_press 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Core & Stability":
        warmup:
          marching 5m
        main straight_sets:
          plank 4x45s rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
          pallof_press 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
          bird_dog 3x10 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
          hollow_hold 3x20s rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 5m
    WEEK 6:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Lower - Strength":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          trap_bar_deadlift 4x4..6 rpe 7..8 rest 120 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x6..8 rpe 7..8 rest 90 seconds
          leg_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Upper - Strength":
        warmup:
          arm_circles 5m
        main straight_sets:
          dumbbell_press 4x6..8 rpe 7..8 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 4x6..8 rpe 7..8 rest 90 seconds
          seated_row 3x8 rpe 7..8 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 50m "Core & Posterior Chain":
        warmup:
          marching 5m
        main straight_sets:
          plank 4x50s rpe 7..8 rest 45 seconds
          back_extension 4x8 rpe 7..8 rest 60 seconds
          pallof_press 3x12 rpe 7..8 rest 45 seconds
          dead_bug 3x12 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 5m
    WEEK 7:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Lower - Mixed Strength":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          trap_bar_deadlift 5x3..5 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          hip_thrust 4x5..6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          goblet_squat 3x6..8 rpe 7..8 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 3x12 rpe 7..8 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Upper - Heavy Sets":
        warmup:
          arm_circles 5m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 5x3..5 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          lat_pulldown 4x6 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x6 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 50m "Core & Stability":
        warmup:
          marching 5m
        main straight_sets:
          plank 4x55s rpe 8 rest 45 seconds
          pallof_press 4x10 rpe 8 rest 45 seconds
          back_extension 4x8 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          bird_dog 3x12 rpe 7..8 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          spinal_twist 5m
    WEEK 8:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Lower - Intensity":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          trap_bar_deadlift 5x3..5 rpe 8..9 rest 150 seconds
          hip_thrust 4x5..6 rpe 8..9 rest 120 seconds
          leg_press 3x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 3x12 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Upper - Intensity":
        warmup:
          arm_circles 5m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 5x3..5 rpe 8..9 rest 150 seconds
          lat_pulldown 4x6 rpe 8..9 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x15 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 50m "Core & Recovery":
        warmup:
          marching 5m
        main straight_sets:
          plank 4x60s rpe 8 rest 45 seconds
          pallof_press 4x12 rpe 8 rest 45 seconds
          back_extension 4x8 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          hollow_hold 3x25s rpe 8 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          cat_cow 5m

  PHASE "Phase 3 - Consolidation & Capacity" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Lower - Balanced":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          trap_bar_deadlift 4x4..6 rpe 7..8 rest 150 seconds
          hip_thrust 4x6 rpe 7..8 rest 120 seconds
          goblet_squat 3x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 3x15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Upper - Balanced":
        warmup:
          arm_circles 5m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x5..6 rpe 7..8 rest 120 seconds
          lat_pulldown 4x6..8 rpe 7..8 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 50m "Core & Movement Quality":
        warmup:
          marching 5m
        main straight_sets:
          plank 4x60s rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
          pallof_press 4x12 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
          bird_dog 3x12 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
          dead_bug 3x15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 5m
    WEEK 10:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Lower - Volume":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          trap_bar_deadlift 4x4..6 rpe 7..8 rest 150 seconds
          hip_thrust 4x6..8 rpe 7..8 rest 120 seconds
          walking_lunge 3x12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 3x15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Upper - Volume":
        warmup:
          arm_circles 5m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x5..6 rpe 7..8 rest 120 seconds
          seated_row 4x8 rpe 7..8 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 50m "Core & Conditioning":
        warmup:
          marching 5m
        main straight_sets:
          plank 4x60s rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
          pallof_press 4x12 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
          back_extension 4x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          mountain_climber 3x30s rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          spinal_twist 5m
    WEEK 11:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Lower - Peak Strength":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          trap_bar_deadlift 5x3..5 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          hip_thrust 4x5 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          leg_press 3x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 3x15 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Upper - Peak Strength":
        warmup:
          arm_circles 5m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 5x3..5 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          lat_pulldown 4x6 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x6 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x15 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 50m "Core & Maintenance":
        warmup:
          marching 5m
        main straight_sets:
          plank 4x60s rpe 8 rest 45 seconds
          pallof_press 4x12 rpe 8 rest 45 seconds
          back_extension 4x10 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          hollow_hold 3x30s rpe 8 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          cat_cow 5m
    WEEK 12:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Lower - Deload & Consolidate":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          trap_bar_deadlift 3x4 rpe 6..7 rest 150 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x6 rpe 6..7 rest 120 seconds
          goblet_squat 3x8 rpe 6..7 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 2x15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Upper - Deload & Consolidate":
        warmup:
          arm_circles 5m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x5 rpe 6..7 rest 120 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x6..8 rpe 6..7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x8 rpe 6..7 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Core & Mobility":
        warmup:
          marching 5m
        main straight_sets:
          plank 3x45s rpe 6..7 rest 45 seconds
          pallof_press 3x10 rpe 6..7 rest 45 seconds
          bird_dog 3x10 rpe 6..7 rest 45 seconds
          dead_bug 3x12 rpe 6..7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 5m
